description: Verify that Cyclic OfferService Session-IDs strictly increment across iterations
approach:
[Objective]
Session ID monotonicity: each cyclic OfferService must increment Session ID — protects replay detection.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService #1 (sid=N).
2. DUT → Tester: cyclic OfferService #2 (sid=N+1).

[Pass condition]
sid increased between #1 and #2.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_session_id_did_not_increment: OfferService Session ID did not increment
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_second_offer: No second OfferService within listen window
